subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw keep this issue as the umbrella for native batching, context block lifecycle, and plan/workflow enforcement, and which parts belong in core runtime/API versus plugin or ClawHub surfaces?
rationale: The request adds native tool schemas, local persisted context semantics, new settings/config, and runner enforcement policy; repository policy treats those as compatibility- and product-sensitive decisions rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Split Into Design Tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

options.title: Make Narrow Issues Canonical
options.body: Use the existing context and enforcement issues as canonical for those portions and retain or open a separate batch-tools tracker for the remaining native batching work.

options.title: Reject Core Orchestration Expansion
options.body: Narrow or close the umbrella if maintainers decide AI-controlled context blocks and plan enforcement are too much heavy orchestration for core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest adjacent history across strict-agentic planning, tool execution, context pruning, and prior product-review comments on this issue.
